page.layout: One printed page (p. 130), one text column, running text only. No marginal notes. A catchword at the lower right. The right edge of the neighbouring page shows at the far right of the scan and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: los[?] fideles, ut citati & rogati reddant ra-tionem suæ professionis & fidei. Christus autem etiam conticuisse legitur ad interrogata pharisæorum & sacerdotum. 16 Complures ex episcopis Romanis satis multa castigasse & damnasse, quæ longo usu obtinuerant in curia pontificis & ecclesiâ: felicius ergo plura corrigi potuisse, si doctores protestantium sese illis adjunxissent. resp. Protestantium doctores non sunt accersiti, ut cum aliis disceptarent & judicarent controversias religionis, sed ut audirent sententiam, videlicet damnatoriam, si decretis pontificis & cleri Romani parere nol-lent: sicuti docuimus supra pa. 76.

Deinde licet quidam ex doctoribus pontificiis liberius locuti sint, & castigaverint impietatem cleri, tamen omnes & singuli subjecerunt se placitis pontificis, tanquam supremi judicis: omnes namque fuerunt Romanæ sedi obstricti juramento, cujus summam notavimus supra p. 75.

page.notes: Faint, barely legible print lies below the text block near the bottom centre, around the page number line; it is too faint to read and is not transcribed. The "16" before "Complures" is set small and is read with some doubt. The first word "los" at the top is uncertain. The page reference "75" falls on its own line at the left after "supra p."; it is joined to the sentence here.
